content: Delivered: Replaced sam_hdr_name2tid and sam_hdr_tid2name with pure Rust. HeaderView now pre-builds a HashMap<Vec<u8>, u32> cache for name→tid at construction. tid2name uses direct C array indexing with bounds check (no FFI call). 3 differential tests verify equivalence with C oracle. Created follow-up CL-31 for HashMap key efficiency refactor across all caches. All 239 tests pass, clippy clean.
